user_stories.title: Implement shallow-wide transformer with gated MLP
user_stories.description: Modify causal_lob_forecaster.py to use 2 layers, 96 hidden dim, 4 heads, with gated MLP (SwiGLU) in final layers. Keep total params <15k.
acceptance_criteria: Forward pass works on CPU with batch=32
Gradient flow stable in first 100 steps
user_stories.verification: python -c 'from src.models.causal_lob_forecaster import CausalLOBForecaster; m=CausalLOBForecaster(hidden_dim=96, num_layers=2, num_heads=4); print(f"Params: {sum(p.numel() for p in m.parameters())}")'

user_stories.title: Configure aggressive training schedule for early gains
user_stories.description: Update train.py with LR=0.001 (cosine decay), dropout schedule 0.3→0.1, teacher forcing decay 0.7→0.3 over 5 epochs, Pearson loss weight=0.8.
acceptance_criteria: LR decays from 0.001 to 0.0001 by epoch 5

user_stories.title: Prevent OOM crashes with batch/memory optimization
user_stories.description: Set batch_size=32, disable gradient checkpointing, ensure tensors are moved to CPU immediately after forward pass, add memory monitoring.
user_stories.verification: python src/train.py --epochs 1 --batch-size 32 2>&1 | grep -E '(RAM|OOM|Killed)' || echo 'No OOM detected'
